Subject: Notes & actions — Jan 15 SIG/SOC2 intake (NovaMed)

Hi all —

Thanks for the productive intake today. Quick capture of notes and action items so nothing falls through the cracks. Please reply if I missed anything.

Meeting summary:
- Scope confirmed: Redwood endpoints used by NovaMed clinical analytics; PHI metadata only (no raw PHI stored). Data residency: US-only.
- Key risk areas: identity provisioning, network segmentation for inference clusters, access to audit logs, and configuration drift on model endpoints.

Decisions made:
- SIG questionnaire will be the canonical checklist for initial evidence (NovaMed will mark owners).
- Redwood will provide an evidence map PDF and a shortlist of log extracts we need.

Action items (owner — due):
1) NovaMed — populate "evidence owner" column in SIG sheet & upload to shared Drive (Mark Rivera) — due 2026-01-20
2) NovaMed — export audit-log sample (CSV, 30 days) and network diagram (png/pdf) — (Mark Rivera) — due 2026-01-22
3) Redwood — populate SOC2 evidence map with likely artifacts and examples, flag any gaps (Grace + Marissa) — due 2026-01-19
4) Redwood — provide list of specific log fields and recommended anonymization steps for CSV exports (Karthik) — due 2026-01-18

Requested evidence (short list):
- Infrastructure inventory (hosts, regions)
- Network diagram showing subnets and ingress/egress points to Redwood endpoints
- Audit logs (authn/authz events, admin actions) — CSV recommended
- Change control tickets for model config updates (or pointer to ticketing system)

Attachments distributed: SOC2-Evidence-Map.pdf (stub)

Next steps:
- NovaMed upload populated SIG sheet to shared Drive by 1/20
- Redwood to review uploads and book technical walkthrough if needed (target week of 1/26)

Thanks again —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Solutions Manager
